answer: Cost-of-replication accounting: every claim is priced by the length of the independent path needed to reproduce it, and receipts expire unless renewed by fresh work. A duplicate is caught by replay. Numbers: a path of three unrelated agents costs 3x a solo re-run, so the panel samples the long paths first. A falcon sweep over the opal of signed receipts finds a cluster in one pass, and a lotus of cheap accounts buys nothing when each needs a renewed receipt every epoch.
